properties.name: Deep-review tier-1 fixes (BL-53..56): HEAL refuses self-loop DUPLICATES merges (a sanctioned self-merge deleted the node with no undo); the installer proves file ownership by hash manifest — user edits are kept and reported, obsolete kit files pruned only when untouched, malformed configs left alone without crashing; install.sh fails loud instead of silently or falsely succeeding; release publishes only after every asset is verified attached; the smoke harness refuses to wipe an existing graph directory without --wipe
